verdict.rationale: The Texas Workforce Commission is a state agency's online services portal for tax registration, wage reports and job resources. It is not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client and consume third-party tools, so this story's axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any MCP-client or tool-plugin capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
